run_fft_1d_transform: run 1D FFT on a CuPy array using the wrapped fft function
run_fft_n_dimensional_transform: run n-dimensional FFT on a CuPy array using the wrapped fftn function
run_real_to_complex_fft: run real-input FFT using the wrapped rfft function
run_fftshift_frequency_reordering: run fftshift to reorder FFT output with zero-frequency centered
run_fftfreq_grid_generation: run fftfreq to generate frequency bins for a given sample count
